environment.isolation: unique schema first in search_path with public extensions available

cases.name: real_owner_migrations
cases.expected: isolated PostgreSQL applies Outbox, Taxonomy, Flex prerequisite, Forum, and Search migrations before exercising the harness

cases.name: real_forum_writes
cases.expected: Forum category, topic, and approved reply fixtures are created through the existing owner services

cases.name: durable_forum_reindex
cases.expected: a Forum ReindexRequested event enters SearchIngestionHandler with the real Forum projection source and durable inbox path

cases.name: atomic_scope_replacement
cases.expected: current-tenant stale category, topic, reply, and orphan rows are deleted before the staged owner projection is inserted in one projector transaction

cases.name: localized_owner_routes
cases.expected: category, topic, and approved-reply payload routes exactly match the localized descriptors owned by Forum

cases.name: search_projection_acceptance
cases.expected: canonical_search_result_url accepts each rebuilt owner route without rebuilding Forum identity

cases.name: legacy_route_removal
cases.expected: the rebuilt tenant has no /modules/forum route payloads

cases.name: stale_orphan_removal
cases.expected: a stale Forum document without an owner source row is removed by full scope replacement

cases.name: tenant_isolation
cases.expected: another tenant's stale Forum document remains byte-for-byte outside the rebuilt scope

runtime_promotion_requirements: execute the PostgreSQL test target with RUSTOK_SEARCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL or DATABASE_URL
retain successful Search inbox completion and staged replacement evidence
run a complete Forum Search reindex in the target environment
confirm GraphQL, native storefront, Search admin, and admin shell expose only localized Forum routes
